notes.title: MY HERO ACADEMIA: All’s Justice - First info revealed!
notes.content: [h2]The hero, the villain, the journey: it all leads to this. A new My Hero Academia video game ""[b]MY HERO ACADEMIA: All's Justice[/b]"" is coming soon for ONE LAST SMASH![/h2][p][/p][h3]MY HERO ACADEMIA: All's Justice is the super-powered 3D arena fighter where your favourite characters from the My Hero Academia franchise appear in their latest and most powerful forms that showcases their Quirks to their limits![/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="VTE772kup6k;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Fans will follow Deku and the journeys of other characters in the [b]Final War[/b] between Heroes and Villains, and experience the world-shaking, climactic clash between One For All and All For One.[/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3]Players will be able to enjoy the original My Hero Academia story and experience spectacular [b]3v3 battles[/b]![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683855/9baaff79df9c4c50420ff8029099fbba44e9f1fe.gif"][/img][/p][h3]The producer, Aoba Miyazaki, announced that this new game will feature a [b]huge roster of characters[/b] from the anime. [/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3]More detailed article is available, [b][url="https://bnent.eu/MHAJ-First-Info"]click HERE [/url][/b]to access it.[/h3][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]We do hope fans are excited by the announcement of this brand-new [b]My Hero Academia game[/b]![/h3][p][/p][h3][/h3][h3]You can now add the game to your [b]wishlist[/b]![/h3][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Smash now[/b][/h2][h2][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362050/MY_HERO_ACADEMIA_Alls_Justice/"]MY HERO ACADEMIA: All’s Justice on Steam[/url][/h2]
